jobs.company: Peak Trust Global Real Estate LLC
jobs.title: Creative Director(Content Strategist)
jobs.description:
We’re seeking an experienced Creative Manager with a strong agency background and established creative networks across Dubai and India.

The ideal candidate will have experience collaborating with international agencies, managing creative partnerships and leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality campaigns across markets.

Key Responsibilities

\* Lead creative strategy, campaign development and execution across multiple projects.

\* Manage creative teams and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners.

\* Build and maintain relationships with creative, branding, advertising and digital agencies in Dubai and India, as well as international markets.

\* Identify and manage external agency partnerships to support creative delivery and business objectives.

\* Ensure consistency in brand identity, creative quality and campaign execution.

\* Oversee project timelines, budgets, resources and deliverables.

\* Translate business requirements into impactful creative solutions for diverse audiences.

Requirements

\* Proven experience as a Creative Manager or in a comparable creative leadership position.

\* Strong background in a creative, advertising, branding or digital agency.

\* Demonstrated experience managing creative teams and external agency relationships.

\* Existing professional networks across Dubai and India; international agency exposure is a strong advantage.

\* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative strategy, campaign delivery and brand development.

\* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and organisational skills.

Who We’re Looking For

A commercially aware creative professional who can bridge creative talent, agency partnerships and business objectives across markets.

Pay: From AED8,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience taking an idea from inception to execution?
* What is your salary expectation ?
* Will you require visa sponsorship?

Experience:

* Content creation: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person
